entries.name: TP Held Type Power
entries.description: Tests a permanent held type_power (stacks with TP Type Power Up): Water moves hit 10% harder.

entries.name: TP Held Stat Guard
entries.description: Tests permanent held effects with a when condition plus guard_stages (overlaps TP Guards): Speed x1.1 below half HP and foes can't lower its stats.

entries.name: TP Held Aura
entries.description: Tests a permanent held ally aura: allies on the field take 10% less damage.

entries.name: TP Held Aura Trigger
entries.description: Tests a held ally aura combined with a round_end trigger: allies are sheltered from Overgrown while the holder heals a sixteenth each round.

entries.name: TP Held Permanent Triggers
entries.description: Tests permanent held triggers that fire every time: 50% chance on entering to raise Luck, and a 1% non-contact hit trigger that Chills the attacker.

entries.name: TP Held Field
entries.description: Tests held overworld ops: fewer encounters, double XP and double Bond gains while it leads.

entries.name: TP Held Consumed Enter
entries.description: Tests a consumed enter trigger: on entering, raises Resolve once and is used up.

entries.name: TP Held Consumed Hit
entries.description: Tests a consumed hit trigger with hp_below: eaten when hurt below half HP to heal a quarter.

entries.name: TP Held Consumed Round End
entries.description: Tests a consumed round_end trigger at 50% chance: restores half its energy and is used up when it fires.

entries.name: TP Held Consumed Knockout
entries.description: Tests a consumed knockout trigger: the first knockout fully heals the holder and uses the item up.

entries.name: TP Held Consumed Faint
entries.description: Tests a consumed faint trigger: when the holder faints, the attacker is Shocked (the item is used up).

entries.name: TP Held Per Battle Enter
entries.description: Tests a per_battle enter trigger: once per battle, entering scorches the enemy side.

entries.name: TP Held Per Battle Contact Hit
entries.description: Tests a per_battle contact hit trigger: the first physical hit each battle lowers the attacker's Physical Attack.

entries.name: TP Held Per Battle Round End
entries.description: Tests a per_battle round_end trigger with a field condition: once per battle, heals a tenth at round end if Overgrown is on its side.

entries.name: TP Held Per Battle Knockout
entries.description: Tests a per_battle knockout trigger with underdog: once per battle, a knockout while outnumbered restores half its energy.

entries.name: TP Held Per Battle Faint
entries.description: Tests a per_battle faint trigger: when the holder faints, the attacker takes half its HP in damage.
